value.rationale: A sharp quantitative failure boundary for a natural reversible-chain mixing improvement theorem. It identifies the smallest state dimension, fully classifies attainable memory rates, supplies positive and endpoint examples, and gives exact all-time error laws relevant to stochastic coarse-graining. Not merely one counterexample, a trivial one-step contraction, or a finite numerical slice.
